purpose: Define the portable Forge GUI layer that Havenwild should consume now and Ember should own later.
interactionContracts: Docked panels can be pinned, collapsed, floated, re-docked, and serialized into layouts.
Infinite canvas hosts world view, room view, scene draft view, and canvas-hosted tool windows using the same panel contract.
Every panel exposes a stable tool id, command id set, selection binding, and validation/status binding.
ForgePY/Rust Forge, Havenwild, Cortex, and Ember share visual state names: normal, hover, pressed, active, focused, disabled, warning, danger, success.
migrationRule: Do not duplicate one-off debug-looking UI. Promote common chrome/widgets into the portable layer, then consume them through profile-specific panels.
